purpose: Three-layer data-rights record for the Belka research corpus. Keeps original source license separate from project-specific owner permission and from redistribution status. This file does NOT relicense any source; it records an additional permission overlay where the owner has obtained one. See DATA_RIGHTS_AND_PERMISSIONS.md.

layers_explained.original_license_category: Upstream license/status of the material before Belka used it.
layers_explained.project_permission_category: Whether the owner obtained extra permission for research/model-development use.
layers_explained.redistribution_category: Whether this repository may redistribute the data.

permission_evidence.public_summary: Written permissions for research and model-development use retained privately by the project owner; can be confirmed by the owner at review. Not published in this repository.

redistribution_category.note: Permission to TRAIN on a source does not imply permission to REDISTRIBUTE it. Category B (permissioned_by_owner) raw data is not published from this repository.

books_clean_v2.original_license: copyright_all_rights_reserved (Belarusian literary works; aggregated via RuLit-style sources)
books_clean_v2.notes: Included in Belka research corpus (v3b) under project-specific permission. Original copyright status unchanged and still recorded. Raw redistribution status documented separately and is not granted.

bewikisource_full.notes: Full (less strictly filtered) Wikisource extraction. Work-level rights vary; owner permission covers research/model-development use. Attribution and share-alike obligations of underlying Wikimedia works still apply.

bewikibooks_full.notes: Full Wikibooks extraction. Wikimedia attribution/share-alike obligations still apply.

explicitly_not_claimed: No source is asserted to be public domain by this manifest.
The corpus as a whole is not asserted to be freely redistributable.
Owner permission is not asserted for candidate sources not used in the corpus (e.g. oscar, culturax, opensubtitles, flores200, common_crawl, morphodict-bel for base training).
Project-specific research permission is not a public or unrestricted license and does not grant commercial use.
